[My] light. Unto You, O Lord. Acts 6:8
to Stephen. to 7:29 "two sons". Psalm
refrain: "To You is due." Catholic [Epistle] of James 3:13
"Who is wise" to 4:6 "grace to the humble." Alleluia, Psalm 147:12 "Praise [the Lord], O Jerusalem." Gospel according to John 1:18
"No one has [seen] God" to verse 28 "there he was."
Today begin to read the four Gospels in order: Luke in the morning,
and John at midday, Matthew at the first evening [service],
and Mark at the dismissal; until Pentecost you shall complete the four Gospels up to the discourses on the Passion.
At the first evening, Gospel according to Matthew
4:12 "And when Jesus heard" to verse 25 "and he healed them." Messedi: "The Lord is powerful."
"The earth is the Lord's." Hambartsi Tone 1 [ah] / [adz]: "Glory of the Resurrection." Dismissal Gospel according to Mark 1:11
"And after [John] was delivered up" to verse 20 "they went after Him."

Tuesday. Canticle Tone 1 [ah] / [ak]: "Sing to the Lord." Patres Tone 1 [ak]: "Who for our." Morning
Gospel according to Luke 4:42 "And when it was day" to 5:11 "after Him."
Midday Psalms: 28 [29] "Ascribe to the Lord," "I will exalt You," "In You, O Lord, have I hoped." Acts 7:30
"And when [forty years] were completed" to 8:2 "great lamentation over him." Psalm 5:12 "O Lord, as with a shield," response: "Give ear to my words." Catholic [Epistle] of James
4:7 "Submit yourselves" to verse 17 "it is sin to him." Alleluia, Psalm 20 [21] "The Lord in Your strength." Gospel according to John 1:29 "The next day" to verse 34 "the Son of God."
At the first evening, Gospel according to Matthew
5:1 "And seeing" to verse 16 "who is in heaven."
Messedi: "Your throne," "My heart overflowed." Hambartsi Tone 1 [ah] / [ak]: "The Lord is risen." Dismissal Gospel
according to Mark 1:21 "And they entered" to verse 34 "that He was the Christ."

Wednesday. Canticle Tone 2 [ah] / [bdz]: "Let us bless the Lord." Patres Tone 1 [ak]: "Unoriginate Word." Morning
Gospel according to Luke 5:12 "And it came to pass, when He was" to verse 16 "and He remained in prayer."
Midday Psalms: 31 [32] "Blessed is," "Rejoice,"
"I will bless." Acts 8:3 "But Saul" to
verse 13 "was amazed." Catholic [Epistle] of James 5:1
"Come now" to verse 11 "and merciful."
Alleluia, Psalm 64 [65] "To You is due." Gospel
according to John 1:35 "The next day" to verse 42
"translated, Peter."
At the first evening, Gospel according to Matthew
5:17 "Do not think" to verse 48 "is perfect." Messedi: "The Lord reigns," "He appeared." Hambartsi Tone 2 [ah] / [bdz]: "They came to the tomb."
Dismissal Gospel according to Mark 1:35 "And in the morning" to verse 45 "from every side."

Thursday. Canticle Tone 2 [ah] / [bk]: "Pharaoh." Patres
Tone 1 [ak]: "Who on the throne of glory." Morning
Gospel according to Luke 5:17 "And it came to pass on a certain day" to verse 26 "today strange things." Midday
Psalms: 34 [35] "Plead my cause, O Lord," "The transgressor says," "Fret not." Acts 8:14
"Now when they heard" to verse 25 "they preached the gospel."
Psalm 98 [99] "Exalt." Catholic [Epistle] of James
5:12 "But above all things" to verse 20
"a multitude of sins." Alleluia, Psalm 14 [15]
"Lord, who shall dwell?" Gospel according to John 1:43
"The next day" to verse 51 "of man."
At the first evening, Gospel according to Matthew
6:1 "Take heed" to verse 21 "your heart will be." Messedi: "Sing to the Lord," "Enter before." Hambartsi Tone 2 [ah] / [bk]: "Christ is risen."
Dismissal Gospel according to Mark 2:1 "And when He entered" to verse 12 "we never saw."

Friday. Canticle Tone 3 [ah] / [gdz]: "A helper and protector."
Patres Tone 1 [ak]: "Incomprehensible God." Morning
Gospel according to Luke 5:27 "And after these things" to verse 39 "it is sweeter." Midday
Psalms: 37 [38] "O Lord, rebuke me not in Your wrath," "I said, I will guard," "With patience." Acts 8:26
"An angel of the Lord" to verse 40 "to Caesarea."
Psalm 97 [98] "All have seen." Catholic [Epistle] of
1 Peter 1:1 "Peter, an apostle" to verse 12
"into which things angels." Alleluia, Psalm 92 [93]
"The Lord reigns, He is clothed with majesty." Gospel
according to John 2:1 "And on the third day" to
verse 11 "His disciples."
At the first evening, Gospel according to Matthew
6:22 "The light of the body" to verse 34 "the day's own evil." Messedi: "Come and see," "Our God is a refuge." Hambartsi Tone 3 [ah] / [gdz]: "Today the resurrection" and "With the sign of the cross." Dismissal Gospel
